notes.title: Minor patch 5712b
notes.content:
- New: Option HUD size scale.
- Fix: Gap between game resolution and screen resolution.
- Fix: Glitch with "alphanumeric puzzle" and "cylinder door" if game resolution was not the same as screen resolution.

The old saved games should work, no need to start new story.

notes.title: Major patch 5712
notes.content:
WARNING ! Sorry for the inconvenience but the old saved games could not work anymore, please start a new game.
But if you don’t want to start a new game and use your old saved game (and don’t enjoy this update), you can switch game branch to play previous version:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1626815215
List of changes:

- Up: Basic controlers Xbox360+PS4 (w.i.p)
- Rebuild: Weapons Animations (w.i.p)
- Fix: Alphanumeric puzzle issues
- Fix: Hide weapon on special actions
- Fix: Forest temple's boss glitch and issues
- Fix: Npc unexpected behaviors
- Fix: AI vanish in the reserve
- Fix: Localization 2nd story page
- Fix: Animations on fishes after load game
- Fix: Various texts

notes.title: Minor update 5666c: Brazilian portuguese language
notes.content:
The old saved games should work, no need to start new story.

Thank you very much to Lucas Peixoto for his amazing work as a volunteer for this translation.

notes.title: Minor patch 5666b
notes.content:
The old saved games should work, no need to start new story.

- Fix: The menu option "invert mouse" did not displayed the current setup and was reseted on change.
- Fix: Animations of electrics switches were paused if player does not look at it.
- Fix: Attachment scope enfield was not well placed for AIs.
- Fix: Localization of level names.
- Gameplay change: Disabled player direction in maps. 

Next update

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.content:
This Early Access game is not complete, many features will be upgraded or may be modified in the future.

  Warning !
Throughout the early access period, the saved games may not work after the updates, the player may need to restart a new game.
